title: Science Behind Pixar Opens at Frost Science
igCaption:
The Science Behind Pixar comes to Frost Science this fall.
It explores the science behind Pixar films.
Which Pixar movie would you want explained first?

Sources: WLRN, Resident Magazine, The Miami Guide, Yahoo, Time Out Worldwide

#FrostScience #Pixar #MiamiEvents #ThingsToDoMiami
